review_candidates.title: Staff Software Engineer - Rust (Content Library)
review_candidates.description: Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise. Culture at Scribd, Inc. We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer. We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location. So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude. This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization. About The Team And Role Core Infrastructure builds and operates the foundations of Scribd, Inc.: the paved roads of cloud infrastructure, networking, databases, and observability that let every product team move fast with confidence. Over the past two years, our charter has grown, and today we own the Content Library, the unified storage and governance platform for all content across Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable. The Content Library is one of the more interesting storage problems you'll find anywhere. Nearly twenty years of accumulated content, hundreds of billions of objects in S3, served to hundreds of millions of people every month. It provides transactional storage, dataset transforms with full lineage tracking, low-latency online reads, and the governance layer (access control, trust, deletion propagation) for our most valuable asset: the content that powers our products and our inference-driven features. The core of the platform is written in Rust and built on the excellent Rust data ecosystem (Apache Arrow, Parquet, and DataFusion), with a Python "userland" that teams across the company contribute to directly. If you want a taste of the work, read about Content Crush on our tech blog: https://tech.scribd.com/blog/2026/content-crush.html This role will join an existing team of Senior, Staff, and Principal engineers building the Content Library and Core Infrastructure of Scribd, Inc. for all our production datastores. Working alongside the Content Library's architect and lead engineer, you'll take ownership of the application codebase, drive feature development forward, and help shape where the platform goes as it becomes the foundation for all content at Scribd, Inc. About You You're a systems engineer who loves owning software end-to-end: design, implementation, deployment, operations, and the inevitable "why is this slow?" investigations. You're pragmatic about technology choices; you keep things simple, and you write things down. Design docs, runbooks, and thoughtful code reviews are how you scale yourself. You enjoy being the engineer other teams come to, whether that's reviewing their contributions, unblocking an integration, or turning an ambiguous ask into well-scoped work. You've made agentic AI tools part of your daily engineering practice, and you know they accelerate great engineers rather than replace engineering judgment. Humans stay in the loop on quality, security, and ownership. What You Will Do Design, build, and operate the Content Library's core Rust services (transactional storage, transform coordination, and low-latency retrieval paths) at the scale of hundreds of billions of objects. Own features end-to-end, from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations (observability, on-call, and incident response for the systems you own). Evolve the Python userland (the transform framework, tooling, and developer experience) and support engineers across the company who build on the platform through code reviews, guidance, and well-designed APIs. Lead cross-functional projects with stakeholders in ML, search, product, and data teams: defining roadmaps, milestones, and technical designs that balance scalability, performance, cost, and delivery. Drive performance and cost-efficiency across the stack: query execution (DataFusion), Parquet file layouts, S3 access patterns, caching strategies, and PostgreSQL/Aurora tuning. Strengthen the platform's governance capabilities: data lineage, authorization and access controls, and deletion propagation across brands. Raise the engineering bar on the team through mentorship, design reviews, and improvements to our developer environment, including making agentic AI workflows more effective within our codebase while preserving quality, security, and ownership. Requirements 10+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, distributed, or data-intensive systems. Production experience writing Rust and strong proficiency in Python. A deep understanding of storage and data fundamentals: object storage (S3), columnar formats (Apache Parquet/Arrow), and relational databases (PostgreSQL and/or MySQL). A track record of designing and operating high-throughput, low-latency services, including the operational side: metrics, tracing, alerting, and debugging production systems. Demonstrated technical leadership: leading projects across team boundaries, writing design docs that build alignment, and mentoring engineers. Experience with AWS (e.g., S3, Lambda, ECS, Aurora) and infrastructure-as-code workflows (e.g., Terraform). Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and comfort turning ambiguous requirements into shipped software. Ideally, You Have Direct experience with Apache DataFusion, arrow-rs, the parquet crate, or building query engines and database internals. Contributions to open source, especially in the Rust data ecosystem (delta-rs, Arrow, DataFusion, etc.). Experience with data governance at scale: lineage, access control, GDPR and deletion compliance. A FinOps mindset: you've bent a cloud bill downward through architecture, not just instance right-sizing. Experience building platforms that other engineers build on: SDKs, contribution models, and paved-road developer experience. Recent, hands-on investment in agentic engineering practices, using tools like Claude Code as a core part of your development workflow while keeping human review at the center of quality and security. At Scribd, Inc. your base pay is one part of your total compensation package and is determined within a range. Our pay ranges are based on the local cost of labor benchmarks for each specific role, level, and geographic location. San Francisco is our highest geographic market in the United States. In the state of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $176,500 [minimum salary in our lowest geographic market within California] to $275,000 [maximum salary in our highest geographic market within California]. In the United States, outside of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $145,000 [minimum salary in our lowest US geographic market outside of California] to $261,500 [maximum salary in our highest US geographic market outside of California]. In Canada, the reasonably expected salary range is between $184,500 CAD[minimum salary in our lowest geographic market] to $244,500 CAD[maximum salary in our highest geographic market]. We carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including but not limited to experience; job-related skill sets; relevant education or training; and other business and organizational needs. The salary range listed is for the level at which this job has been scoped. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for a competitive equity ownership, and a comprehensive and generous benefits package. Working at Scribd, Inc. Are you currently based in a location where Scribd, Inc. can employ you? Employees must have their primary residence in or near one of the following cities. This includes surrounding metro areas or locations within a typical commuting distance: United States Atlanta | Austin | Boston | Dallas | Denver | Chicago | Houston | Jacksonville | Los Angeles | Miami | New York City | Phoenix | Portland | Sacramento | Salt Lake City | San Diego | San Francisco | Seattle | Washington D.C. Canada Ottawa | Toronto | Vancouver Mexico Mexico City Benefits At Scribd, Inc. Scribd Flex (flexible work model) Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage Mental health support and disability coverage Generous paid time off, including vacation, sick time, holidays, winter break, volunteer time, and sabbaticals Paid parental leave and family support benefits Retirement matching and employee equity Learning and development programs and professional growth opportunities Wellness and home office stipends Complimentary access to the Scribd, Inc. suite of products Enterprise access to leading AI tools Get to Know Scribd, Inc. About Scribd, Inc. Life at Scribd, Inc. We want our interview process to be accessible to everyone. You can inform us of any reasonable adjustments we can make to better accommodate your needs by emailing accommodations@scribd.com about the need for adjustments at any point in the interview process. If you apply for a job with Scribd, Inc. or otherwise engage with us in connection with employment (including as an employee, contractor, or other personnel), the personal information we process in that context is subject to our Employee and Applicant Privacy Policy, which is available here . Scribd, Inc. is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply, and believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.

review_candidates.title: AI Engineer
review_candidates.description: We're hiring an AI Engineer to be the technical builder on our Automation & AI team, and the bridge between that team and our Tech team. Our Automation & AI Specialist solves problems with low-code and RPA tools. You make that work go further: you automate processes end to end, connect our systems, remove technical blockers, build the shared foundations that let the whole company use AI safely, and take on the builds that genuinely need code. Not every problem needs AI, and a reliable automation is often the best answer. Where AI does add value, you'll build agents that don't just answer questions, but take real actions in our tools and systems. The team does three things. It builds solutions to real business problems, it runs the platform that every automation and AI use case relies on, and it enables' people across the company to use automation and AI well in their own work. You'll work across all three. You'll also be the link to our Tech team. You'll turn business problems into clear technical requirements, work with engineers on security, code review and deployment, and explain technical limits to business teams in plain language. Something that starts as an internal tool often ends up improving the player experience, so we care about the outcome, not where the user sits. You might be right for this if you Have built and shipped something with LLM APIs to real users, and kept it running Test AI output with evals and data Get curious when a model gives two different answers to the same question, and can explain why it happens Know when a prompt change is enough and when you need retrieval, tools or a different model Enjoy integrations and infrastructure: getting systems to talk to each other reliably Get real satisfaction from automating a manual process end to end, whether or not it needs AI Like the idea of building one thing that ten workflows reuse Enjoy translating between people: turning a business problem into a technical requirement, and a technical limit into plain language Would rather ship something small that works this month than something perfect next quarter Key Responsibilities Automation & integration engineering Find manual, repetitive processes across the business and automate them end to end Build event-driven automations triggered by webhooks, system events and message queues, so processes run the moment something happens Build and maintain API integrations between our internal systems and third-party platforms, including handling pagination, rate limits, authentication and token refresh Build scheduled and batch jobs that sync, transform and move data reliably between systems Write custom code steps, scripts and lightweight services (Python or JavaScript/TypeScript) that extend low-code and RPA workflows where they fall short Build browser and UI automation in code for systems that have no API Engineer automations to production standard: idempotency, retries with backoff, dead-letter handling, alerting and clear failure logs Keep automations in version control with testing and deployment pipelines, not just in a workflow editor Choose the simplest approach that works: low-code, code, RPA or AI, and don't add AI where a rule or a script does the job Measure the time and errors each automation saves, so impact is clear AI agents & LLM solutions Design and build advanced AI agents that handle real tasks across the business: answering questions, processing requests and taking actions in our tools and systems Start with agents that support our teams, and expand to ones that serve players directly as they prove value Give agents the tools to act safely, with clear permissions, limits on what they can do, and defined points where a human steps in Ground agents in our documentation, systems and code so their output is accurate and useful Build multi-step and multi-agent setups where a single prompt isn't enough Compare models and providers, and pick the right one for each job based on quality, cost, speed and data privacy Make build vs. buy recommendations backed by numbers, including when an existing vendor is the better answer AI platform & connectors Help set up one controlled way for the company to access AI models, with cost tracking, logging and protection of personal data Build and maintain a company knowledge layer so AI tools can use our documentation, policies and procedures accurately Build secure, permissioned connectors to company systems via APIs and MCP that both workflows and AI agents can use Create reusable tools, APIs and components the wider team can plug into their workflows Support our automation infrastructure: reliability, error handling, logging, credentials and version control Building with the Automation & AI team Remove technical blockers for the Automation & AI Specialist: custom integrations, code steps in workflows, awkward APIs and authentication Integrate LLMs into workflows wherever they add value, and test them on real data Take on the builds that low-code and RPA tools can't do well Build internal AI assistants that handle real tasks, starting small and expanding as they prove value Quality, safety & governance Set a baseline before you ship, so improvement is arguable in numbers Build evaluation sets from real data and use them to measure accuracy, consistency and hallucination rate Add logging, tracing and monitoring to everything you deploy, and roll back quickly when something degrades Defend against prompt injection, data leakage and harmful or off-topic output Track cost and latency, and keep both under control as usage grows Help keep an inventory of where AI is used and what data it touches Bridge to Tech & enablement Act as the technical link between the Tech team and the Automation & AI team Translate business needs into clear technical requirements, and explain technical limits to business teams in plain language Work with engineering on code review, security, deployment and shared standards Help colleagues use automation and AI tools effectively and safely, with guides, templates and examples Document what you build with runbooks and clear ownership Anything that interacts with players or affects their accounts is held to a higher standard: clear AI disclosure, human escalation, full logging, and testing before release. We operate under strict regulations, that you'll help us build in line with. Requirements Required 2+ years of experience in software, data or ML engineering, or a similar technical role Shipped AI agents or LLM-powered applications to real users. Send us examples of what you've built Strong Python and solid SQL Comfortable with APIs, webhooks, authentication and data structures Experience building production automations in code: event-driven workflows, API integrations, scheduled jobs and data syncs, with proper error handling, retries and idempotency Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic or similar), prompt engineering, retrieval (RAG) and tool or function calling Experience with an agent or orchestration framework (LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex or equivalent) Experience evaluating non-deterministic systems: building test sets, measuring quality and catching regressions Understanding of LLM security risks such as prompt injection and data leakage Strong English, written and spoken Preferred Model Context Protocol (MCP) or multi-agent systems TypeScript or JavaScript, and building simple front ends or internal apps (e.g. Next.js, Streamlit) Relational databases such as Postgres, including vector search (e.g. pgvector) Experience with n8n, Make or other low-code automation tools, and RPA tools (UiPath, Power Automate or similar) Browser automation with code (Playwright, Selenium or similar) Message queues, background job runners or serverless functions (e.g. SQS, Pub/Sub, Celery, AWS Lambda) LLM observability tools (Langfuse, LangSmith or similar) A major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP), Docker and CI/CD What We're Really Looking For Agency. review_candidates.description: We're hiring an AI Engineer to be the technical builder on our Automation & AI team, and the bridge between that team and our Tech team. Our Automation & AI Specialist solves problems with low-code and RPA tools. You make that work go further: you automate processes end to end, connect our systems, remove technical blockers, build the shared foundations that let the whole company use AI safely, and take on the builds that genuinely need code. Not every problem needs AI, and a reliable automation is often the best answer. Where AI does add value, you'll build agents that don't just answer questions, but take real actions in our tools and systems. The team does three things. It builds solutions to real business problems, it runs the platform that every automation and AI use case relies on, and it enables' people across the company to use automation and AI well in their own work. You'll work across all three. You'll also be the link to our Tech team. You'll turn business problems into clear technical requirements, work with engineers on security, code review and deployment, and explain technical limits to business teams in plain language. Something that starts as an internal tool often ends up improving the player experience, so we care about the outcome, not where the user sits. You might be right for this if you Have built and shipped something with LLM APIs to real users, and kept it running Test AI output with evals and data Get curious when a model gives two different answers to the same question, and can explain why it happens Know when a prompt change is enough and when you need retrieval, tools or a different model Enjoy integrations and infrastructure: getting systems to talk to each other reliably Get real satisfaction from automating a manual process end to end, whether or not it needs AI Like the idea of building one thing that ten workflows reuse Enjoy translating between people: turning a business problem into a technical requirement, and a technical limit into plain language Would rather ship something small that works this month than something perfect next quarter Key Responsibilities Automation & integration engineering Find manual, repetitive processes across the business and automate them end to end Build event-driven automations triggered by webhooks, system events and message queues, so processes run the moment something happens Build and maintain API integrations between our internal systems and third-party platforms, including handling pagination, rate limits, authentication and token refresh Build scheduled and batch jobs that sync, transform and move data reliably between systems Write custom code steps, scripts and lightweight services (Python or JavaScript/TypeScript) that extend low-code and RPA workflows where they fall short Build browser and UI automation in code for systems that have no API Engineer automations to production standard: idempotency, retries with backoff, dead-letter handling, alerting and clear failure logs Keep automations in version control with testing and deployment pipelines, not just in a workflow editor Choose the simplest approach that works: low-code, code, RPA or AI, and don't add AI where a rule or a script does the job Measure the time and errors each automation saves, so impact is clear AI agents & LLM solutions Design and build advanced AI agents that handle real tasks across the business: answering questions, processing requests and taking actions in our tools and systems Start with agents that support our teams, and expand to ones that serve players directly as they prove value Give agents the tools to act safely, with clear permissions, limits on what they can do, and defined points where a human steps in Ground agents in our documentation, systems and code so their output is accurate and useful Build multi-step and multi-agent setups where a single prompt isn't enough Compare models and providers, and pick the right one for each job based on quality, cost, speed and data privacy Make build vs. buy recommendations backed by numbers, including when an existing vendor is the better answer AI platform & connectors Help set up one controlled way for the company to access AI models, with cost tracking, logging and protection of personal data Build and maintain a company knowledge layer so AI tools can use our documentation, policies and procedures accurately Build secure, permissioned connectors to company systems via APIs and MCP that both workflows and AI agents can use Create reusable tools, APIs and components the wider team can plug into their workflows Support our automation infrastructure: reliability, error handling, logging, credentials and version control Building with the Automation & AI team Remove technical blockers for the Automation & AI Specialist: custom integrations, code steps in workflows, awkward APIs and authentication Integrate LLMs into workflows wherever they add value, and test them on real data Take on the builds that low-code and RPA tools can't do well Build internal AI assistants that handle real tasks, starting small and expanding as they prove value Quality, safety & governance Set a baseline before you ship, so improvement is arguable in numbers Build evaluation sets from real data and use them to measure accuracy, consistency and hallucination rate Add logging, tracing and monitoring to everything you deploy, and roll back quickly when something degrades Defend against prompt injection, data leakage and harmful or off-topic output Track cost and latency, and keep both under control as usage grows Help keep an inventory of where AI is used and what data it touches Bridge to Tech & enablement Act as the technical link between the Tech team and the Automation & AI team Translate business needs into clear technical requirements, and explain technical limits to business teams in plain language Work with engineering on code review, security, deployment and shared standards Help colleagues use automation and AI tools effectively and safely, with guides, templates and examples Document what you build with runbooks and clear ownership Anything that interacts with players or affects their accounts is held to a higher standard: clear AI disclosure, human escalation, full logging, and testing before release. We operate under strict regulations, that you'll help us build in line with. Requirements Required 2+ years of experience in software, data or ML engineering, or a similar technical role Shipped AI agents or LLM-powered applications to real users. Send us examples of what you've built Strong Python and solid SQL Comfortable with APIs, webhooks, authentication and data structures Experience building production automations in code: event-driven workflows, API integrations, scheduled jobs and data syncs, with proper error handling, retries and idempotency Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic or similar), prompt engineering, retrieval (RAG) and tool or function calling Experience with an agent or orchestration framework (LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex or equivalent) Experience evaluating non-deterministic systems: building test sets, measuring quality and catching regressions Understanding of LLM security risks such as prompt injection and data leakage Strong English, written and spoken Preferred Model Context Protocol (MCP) or multi-agent systems TypeScript or JavaScript, and building simple front ends or internal apps (e.g. Next.js, Streamlit) Relational databases such as Postgres, including vector search (e.g. pgvector) Experience with n8n, Make or other low-code automation tools, and RPA tools (UiPath, Power Automate or similar) Browser automation with code (Playwright, Selenium or similar) Message queues, background job runners or serverless functions (e.g. SQS, Pub/Sub, Celery, AWS Lambda) LLM observability tools (Langfuse, LangSmith or similar) A major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP), Docker and CI/CD What We're Really Looking For Agency. You find the problem, not just the ticket. When something blocks you, you find another way Curiosity. You try new models and tools because you find it interesting, not because someone told you to Pragmatism. You'd rather ship a simple solution today than a perfect one next quarter, and you'll happily buy instead of build when it makes sense. You know not every problem needs AI Rigour. You don't trust AI output you haven't measured. You know a demo isn't a product Responsibility. In our industry a wrong answer can affect real people. Safety is part of the craft, not an afterthought Communication. You can explain how AI works, and where its limits are, to engineers and non-engineers alike, without being condescending Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new role on a new team. You'll help define it How does Success Look like in the first 90 Days: Learn, Connect, Identify Month 1: Learn and unblock Learn how our business works: casino and sportsbook operations, key workflows and the regulatory landscape Map our systems, existing automations and current AI use with the Automation & AI Lead, the Specialist and the Tech team Fix the first technical blockers on the Specialist's quick wins Ship one small automation or improvement that people notice Month 2: Foundations Set up a first version of controlled AI access with logging and cost tracking Put evaluation and monitoring foundations in place that every future AI project can reuse Build a knowledge layer for one area, such as our Confluence documentation Deliver a first reusable connector (API or MCP) that a live workflow uses Write a build vs. buy recommendation for one larger opportunity, with cost, quality and compliance numbers Month 3: Early results Automate at least one manual process end to end that saves a team measurable time Launch one AI agent that takes real actions in one of our systems, with baseline metrics Expand your first pilot based on feedback, or retire it if it isn't working Hand over at least one reusable tool or API the Automation & AI team uses in their workflows Present results and a proposed AI roadmap to leadership Benefits Working for Rhino includes plenty of perks. What we offer: Competitive salary based on your knowledge & experience Quarterly performance bonus split on personal objectives and company performance €500 Yearly Wellness & Mindfulness allowance to support an active lifestyle Flexibility & a work-life blend through our Hybrid Working environment Work from anywhere with our 30 days "overseas working" Diverse, dynamic, fun environment with happy and helpful colleagues Learning & Development opportunities to invest in your personal development Fresh fruit, healthy snacks & food are available at the office everyday - and of course, good tea & coffee Free parking, table tennis, lounge area, plenty of meeting rooms and sea views at our ergonomic office Regular social events to strengthen long lasting relationships Enjoy a "Me Day" on your birthday Paid time off, including extra days for special life events AXA Private Hospital & Dental Insurance Coverage Form an active part of our talent acquisition, with our Referral Bonus And to top it off, a great culture! Join us at Rhino Entertainment and unleash your full potential in a vibrant and rewarding career! 🎉 Our Story Rhino Entertainment Group is a fast-growing online gaming operator that was founded in 2020. Winner of the EGR Rising Operator of the Year Award 2023 and iGaming Idol Employer of The Year Award 2023, the company has a multi-brand strategy. Rhino group is committed to providing its players with the best possible gaming experience supported by a cutting-edge gaming platform. Our Culture "We are a community of passionate, committed, driven and fun-loving people who are united by a shared mission to deliver world-class entertainment to our players in a vibrant and dynamic environment. Our culture identity is rooted in our curiosity, our sense of community and unwavering drive for success. We cherish each person's unique qualities and contributions, and we encourage our team members to take ownership, think creatively, find solutions and enjoy the process of achieving our goals!" DEIB We are proud to have so many diverse backgrounds, cultures, perspectives, and ideas represented within our Rhino community, which fuels an authentic workplace and a strong sense of belonging. This broad spectrum helps us achieve a supportive working environment where everyone can make the best use of their skills, free from discrimination or harassment. Diversity goes hand in hand with promoting equal opportunities for all current and future employees and at Rhino, we are committed to ensure fairness in our recruitment process. How We Work At Rhino we very much believe in supporting flexible working arrangements! By blending working from our vibrant offices and using the latest tech to work from home, through our Hybrid Working environment, we firmly believe that we can create an effective, balanced, and collaborative working experience to help us achieve our goals!

review_candidates.title: Senior Full Stack Software Developer - Observability
review_candidates.description: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI. What is The Role: We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Streams UI team, where you'll have the chance to shape and enhance our user interface, making it more intuitive and engaging for our users. In this role, you'll work on Fleet. Fleet is the central management experience for Elastic Agent in Kibana. You'll also work on Streams. Streams is our new tool for handling log data. This includes ingesting, organizing, parsing, enriching, and setting retention for the data. You will be part of a skilled group of engineers and designers. You will contribute your expertise and learn from others. If you enjoy tackling complex challenges and want to make a meaningful impact on our product, we’d love to hear from you. What You Will Be Doing: Design and implement intuitive user interface components that enhance user commitment, using TypeScript, React, and Node.js. Integrate front-end elements seamlessly with back-end services to ensure a smooth user experience. Conduct usability testing and gather user feedback to drive continuous improvements. Own complex, loosely-defined problems end-to-end: shape the approach, split the work if needed, make the key technical decisions, and deliver. Lead discussions on architecture and system design. During these discussions, consider trade-offs. Also, think about backwards compatibility, performance, and scale. Establish coding standards and ensure the team adheres to them throughout the development process. Promote reusable components to improve efficiency and implement automated testing and deployment to maintain code quality. Evaluate new technologies for potential integration and document best practices to facilitate team-wide knowledge sharing. Conduct thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices. Offer constructive feedback and identify potential security vulnerabilities in the codebase. Focus on maintaining code readability and facilitate discussions with team members to address any findings from the code review. Collaborate async across timezones with a fully-distributed team, working in the open on GitHub and in Slack. Partner closely with designers and product managers to apprehend user experience goals and translate their mockups into functional UI components. Ensure a consistent visual design across all UI elements. Participate in brainstorming sessions to generate innovative ideas for enhancing the user interface. What You Bring: Solid production experience with full-stack JavaScript, preferably TypeScript; React on the front end and Node.js on the back end. Some experience with Reactflow is a plus. A track record of leading non-trivial projects end-to-end, with real design ownership and minimal guidance. Proficient architecture and system-design judgment, including in large, existing codebases. Successfully designed and launched multiple user interface components that significantly increased user commitment. You should have experience using AI-assisted development tools. These tools can help you develop features faster, fix complex systems, and improve existing codebases. Exemplary written and verbal communication, and a genuine excitement for async collaboration and knowledge-sharing. A multiplier mindset! You make the engineers around you better. A generalist streak and a user-focused mindset, with consideration for the people using your software. Bonus Points: Experience with the Elastic stack, observability tooling, or log/data-ingestion pipelines. Go, Kubernetes, or cloud-native application development experience. Experience building large user interfaces that manage a lot of data. This includes skills in search, filtering, and tables. You should also have experience working with streaming or real-time data. Prior open-source / working-in-the-open experience, or time on a developer-facing platform team. Experience mentoring engineers or leading a small project team. Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People: As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do. We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do. Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary Health coverage for you and your family in many locations Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles Generous number of vacation days each year Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave Security & Privacy Responsibilities: Take ownership of protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of organizational data and systems by following applicable privacy and security policies, standards, and procedures. Ensure that all individual contributions follow Elastic’s Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF). Proactively participate in mandatory role-based training to ensure personal technical execution consistently aligns with the highest standards of data protection, data privacy, and system resilience. Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation. We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission. Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws and can view the following posters linked below: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Poster Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) Poster Elasticsearch develops and distributes technology and information that is subject to U.S. and other countries’ export controls and licensing requirements for individuals who are located in or are nationals of the following sanctioned countries and regions: Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, or Russia, including the Ukrainian territories annexed by Russia (The Crimea region of Ukraine, The Donetsk People's Republic (DNR), The Luhansk People's Republic (LNR), Kherson or Zaporizhzhia). If you are located in or are a national of one of the listed countries or regions, an export license may be required as a condition of your employment in this role. Please note that national origin and/or nationality do not affect eligibility for employment with Elastic. Please see here for our Privacy Statement. Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets. The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position. The typical starting salary range for this role is: €87.300—€138.100 EUR
